D1_inverse_length_nonimplication.D1_L6over5: finite because c_D1 is constant and sum_n 2^-n<infinity
D1_inverse_length_nonimplication.construction: on disjoint b-bands of width 2^-n, partition the unit r-fibre into 2^(n^2) equal open intervals; use uniform 2D density and constant incidence rank B=14
D1_inverse_length_nonimplication.defect_growth: D_Z(n)>=n^2-ceil(log2(C_p))-2 for all sufficiently large n
D1_inverse_length_nonimplication.logical_scope: an exact standard-Borel uniform-area partition model showing that the currently certified disintegration, finite mass, and D1 rank moment do not imply the required inverse-length/defect moment; it is not asserted to be an actual billiard fibre
D1_inverse_length_nonimplication.missing_moment_diverges: 2^-n*(6/5)^D_Z(n) does not tend to zero; successive ratios eventually dominate (1/2)*(6/5)^(2n+1)
D1_inverse_length_nonimplication.physical_mass: band n has mass 2^-n, so total mass is finite

cemetery_frontier.weak_discarded_mass: m(E_M(s,n)^c)->0 at fixed (s,n), and m((E_M^global)^c)->0 on the countable finite-mass first-return union, by monotone convergence

physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.endpoint_scope: internal endpoints have exactly one owner; the two outer open-interval endpoints remain in the already null regular-boundary cemetery
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.exact_outer_disintegration: integrating K_par over b and summing the countable component/interval/path codes reconstructs mu_s on the regular arbitrary-R_n registry modulo its null boundary
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.finite_fibre_Borel_projection: the Round35 record space is Borel and the projection forgetting (natural-short-cell-k,image-recut-rank) has finite fibres; Lusin-Novikov therefore makes its image Borel and supplies Borel record enumerations
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.finite_rank_path_derivative_product: D_path(y)=product_{i=1}^n(150*2^B_i)<infinity for every fixed finite incidence-rank path
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.grouping_projection: forget natural-short-cell-k and image-recut-rank; retain exactly one complete positive source-fibre interval and all of its deterministic source cells/image recuts
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.half_open_endpoint_owner: use oriented half-open natural cells [k*1e-90,(k+1)*1e-90), clipped to the open source interval; use the same one-sided owner for image recuts
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.kernel_identity_scope: both identities hold after pulling the deterministic image recuts back to the source restriction; half-open ownership removes internal duplication and only the pre-existing null outer boundary is omitted
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.orientation_lengths: ell_fw(y,j),ell_rev(y,j)>0 are Borel on every regular finite-recut record
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.outer_index_space: standard-Borel: countable component/interval/path codes times the Borel leaf intercept b
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.parameter_scope: every fixed |s|<=1/400 and fixed finite n
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.parent_kernel: K_par(y,A)=the Round35 collision-SRB leaf kernel restricted to the complete interval group y
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.recordwise_finite_J_reason: finite sum of finite positive-length terms
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.same_ID_two_view_join: the deterministic image recuts are pulled back to the identical Round35 restriction ID; fw and rev are two alternative finite partitions of one K_par charge, never two charges
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.source_interval_geometry: the complete positive interval lies in one bounded C24 source chart, so its Euclidean carrier length L_src(y) is finite
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.upstream_recut_compatibility: the half-open representative only retypes shared null endpoints of the frozen deterministic recuts; it changes no positive-mass Round35 restriction
physical_Borel_whole_family_grouping.why_each_group_has_finitely_many_cells: the bounded source interval has finitely many 1e-90 cells, and the uniform finite rank-path derivative product gives every source cell finite image length and hence finite image-recut counts

provenance.depth_scope: every fixed finite first-return depth n

recordwise_properization_and_common_pare.Borel_stopped_kernel_reason: Dbar is integer-valued Borel, so the stopped pushforward is the countable Borel union over {Dbar=d}
recordwise_properization_and_common_pare.conditional_complete_total_clock_weight: after that missing join, Wtilde_r=exp(Dbar/(6*r))*W_r because R0/(4176*r)=Dbar/(6*r)

recordwise_properization_and_common_pare.raw_K_par_type_mismatch_with_Round49: Round49 requires one outer kernel whose fibre G_y is itself proper; pulling two different orientation-specific proper pushforwards back to m_raw does not make the raw K_par geometry proper
recordwise_properization_and_common_pare.raw_common_charge_law: m_raw(dy,dx)=lambda(dy)K_par(y,dx) charges the original physical parent restriction once
recordwise_properization_and_common_pare.recordwise_conclusion: after their respective orientation-specific measure-preserving 696*Dbar evolutions, each pushforward whole family is in Z<C_p*mass; this does not assert that raw K_par is proper
